forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 35 of August, teams completed 2 visits. There were 4 survey and 4 clearance teams active; 38 team-days were worked, with 2 lost to rain or wind. So far, 24 zones have been surveyed and 9 declared free; 26 areas have been released and 12 cleared.

Officer attention: the access feed shows 10 zones closed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried, and no new plan was approved. The current plan is P08.

The forecast, made in week 32 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a P10 to P90 range of 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 11 zones declared free.
